name: NeoFinder
creator: NeoFinder
description: Catalogs online and offline media volumes with thumbnails, metadata and search, helping locate assets for edit projects. Requires macOS 10.15+ on Intel or Apple Silicon. The separate iOS companion has its own requirements.

history.name: NeoFinder
history.summary: Adds macOS 27 compatibility and OPUS cataloging, fixes RAW cataloging on macOS 15.8 and corrects path searches, sidecar metadata and PDF handling. This is the last release supporting macOS 10.15.
